name: The ways out of a computer
what: For each computer, Silo lists its channels, such as the network, ports, files, secrets, the screen, the clipboard and the way in from your Mac, and what each lets through in which direction. Every path by which data can leave the computer is among the paths shown. What the computer can reach is never more than what you, or a rule you set, grant.

suggest.why: You can decide what to give a computer only when one place shows every way out of it.
